amenityFeature.name: Port of entry, customs on site

faq: Can I clear customs at Romora Bay Marina?
Yes. The marina is an official port of entry, and boats can clear customs and immigration directly at the marina.
How big a yacht can Romora Bay take?
Vessels up to 190 feet are welcome in the marina's slips.
The resort closes seasonally from August 17 to November 12.
Sip Sip serves lunch from 11:30am to 4pm and is closed on Tuesdays.
Book rooms online or call 833.717.6499. Reserve slips through the marina reservations page or email marina@romorabay.com.

findings: Two of the marina phone numbers on your marina page dial different numbers than the ones printed (786-535-7322 dials 833-717-6499; 242.333.2325 dials 242-333-2500).
Google's description says "40-slip", the page says "40+ slips": captains want one number.
The 190 ft limit sits in a paragraph; nothing lets a captain check length and power, and the power list shows "408V", likely a typo.
The resort's own phone and location are not visible on the homepage until the booking block.
The homepage leads with a dated pickleball event rather than the two reasons people come: the marina and the rooms.
improvements: A hero that asks one question, by sea or by air, and switches the story, facts and button to match.
A fit-and-power checker for captains, with a prefilled email to the marina team.
Named dockmaster and manager with working contact links.
Rooms, suites and The House in one selector with their own photographs.
Separate Resort and Marina markup so both rank for Harbour Island searches.
